table: B25038 (Tenure by Year Householder Moved Into Unit, owner rows) and B25027 (Mortgage Status by Age of Householder)
title: Owner households by year moved in, and owners with and without a mortgage by householder age, by state and county
geography: Nation, 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico (keyed by postal code), and 3,222 counties and county equivalents (keyed by five-digit FIPS); the four other island areas have no ACS
limits: Estimates only (margins of error are in the source files and are wide for small counties). The year the householder moved in is not the year of purchase or of the current loan, and neither table reports balances or refinancing. Rows are pipe-joined counts in the order of 'columns'. Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands are not in the ACS; a reader takes the nation's shares there, marked as an estimate. The nation row covers the 50 states and D.C. (nationCovers); Puerto Rico is published separately.
